contract:
Contract CoCoMEOrderProducts::chooseSupplier(supplierID: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		supplier: Supplier = Supplier.allInstances()->any(s: Supplier|s.Id = supplierID)
	precondition:
		Supplier.allInstances()->exists(s: Supplier|s.Id = supplierID) and
		self.CurrentOrderProduct.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		self.CurrentOrderProduct.Supplier = supplier and
		result = true
}
